strategy.summary: Reproduce pandas convert_dtypes OverflowError for object-dtype integers outside int64/uint64 range (GH#66517, PR#66791). Build pandas from the buggy commit 9f9b3dfbc0e7 in editable mode, then run the developer's added tests in pandas/tests/series/methods/test_convert_dtypes.py and pandas/tests/frame/methods/test_convert_dtypes.py; they should error on buggy revision and pass on fixed revision.

system_packages: a C/C++ compiler toolchain capable of building pandas Cython extensions
pinned_because: NumPy, python-dateutil, tzdata and Cython have no documented constraint and no era table entry in the evidence, so versions are unpinned; the build uses the current compatible versions for the buggy commit's pyproject build requirements
pyarrow is not pinned by evidence; it is installed only so the pyarrow-backend test is not skipped

strategy.success_criterion: On the buggy revision 9f9b3dfbc0e7 the tests raise OverflowError ('Python int too large to convert to C long') inside convert_dtypes and therefore fail; on the fixed revision convert_dtypes returns object dtype for out-of-range data, UInt64/Int64 for the NA cases, and the tests pass.
strategy.numerical_probe: pd.Series([2**64], dtype=object).convert_dtypes() raising OverflowError on buggy revision versus returning dtype('O') on fixed revision

input_output_examples.buggy_output: OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to C long

risks: The defect is in the object branch with infer_objects=True; the test must run through convert_dtypes default path, which the developer's tests do.
The pyarrow-backend test is skipped via pytest.importorskip if pyarrow is absent, so it will not transition without pyarrow installed; the other tests do not depend on it.
The frame test in pandas/tests/frame/methods/test_convert_dtypes.py is a separate file and its class name is assumed; select it by -k if the class name differs.

Behaviour is platform-independent in the evidence (Python int handling in IntegerArray._safe_cast), so it is not expected to need a special architecture or sanitiser, but the 'C long' message wording may differ on Windows where C long is 32-bit; the transition is still expected to occur because the failing path is overflow on out-of-range values.
Related issue #66519 concerns float64-range inference and is not part of this reproduction; do not conflate it with this failure.
No Python version is stated by the evidence, so the interpreter version is left to the pandas build requirements for the buggy commit.

oracle.reference_source: developer test assertions using tm.assert_series_equal and tm.assert_frame_equal against the original object series
oracle.why: Dtype and object-retention checks are exact; no numeric tolerance applies to integer dtype and value equality.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: convert_dtypes calls IntegerArray._safe_cast on out-of-range Python ints, which raises OverflowError before any assertion runs, so the test errors and fails.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: Fixed revision keeps object dtype for out-of-range values and yields UInt64 or Int64 for the NA cases, so the assert_series_equal and assert_frame_equal checks succeed.
